description: Read the append-only log of every autonomous action the agent has taken, newest first — the real agent_actions trail. Each receipt carries the kind (alert created / briefing authored / wallet transfer), its rationale, the outcome (created rule id / notification id / on-chain signature), the source memories it was grounded in, and the cryptographic signature + signer address when the action was signed by the agent's wallet. Use it to audit what the agent did and why. Omit agentId to aggregate across every agent the credential owns. Paginate with the returned next_cursor. Read-only.

agentId.description: UUID of a specific agent (must be owned by the credential). Omit to aggregate across all your agents.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: pass the next_cursor from a previous call to fetch the next page.

name: list_autopilot_activity
title: List autopilot activity (signed receipts)
